text: Moonshot launched Kimi K3.1 Pro, an open-weight model with a 1M token context window. Full weights are due by Nov 4. Moonshot says it scores 65.7% on Terminal-Bench 4.0, just behind Claude Opus 5.5 (66.4%) and ahead of GPT-6 Astra (58.2%).
